# Hellotickets

> > Hellotickets is a ticketing platform offering Discovery and Seller APIs for travel and activity booking integrations.

Hellotickets provides REST APIs for discovering and selling tickets to tours, attractions, and experiences. The platform supports authentication, localization, and comprehensive API documentation for developers integrating ticketing solutions.

## Key Topics

- Discovery API
- Seller API
- REST API
- Ticketing
- Authentication
- Localization
- API Reference
- HTTP
- Travel and Activities
- Booking Integration
- Developer Documentation

## API Reference

- [Hellotickets API Reference](https://docs-api.hellotickets.com/): API reference for Discovery API and Seller API with authentication docs

## Optional
